title: Item vendors
summary: Who supplies each item. Edit it by hand or import a CSV; ordering and Fix Issues use it.

blocks.text: Setup › **Item vendors** says who supplies each item, for stores whose {pos} has no supplier field. Ordering and Fix Issues use it to group items by vendor.

items: Search an item, then add or change its vendors. The first vendor is the usual one.
**Items without a vendor** shows what is still missing.
Many at once: import a CSV. You see every row and any problems before anything is saved.

blocks.text: On a Toast store the inventory file still decides vendors; this page shows them read-only.
